newsitem.title: FRANCE: Danone says anti-takeover measures not renewed.
newsitem.headline: Danone says anti-takeover measures not renewed.

text.p: The chairman of French food group Danone said in a newspaper interview that measures designed to protect the group against a possible takeover had now expired and were not renewed.
"Our anti-takeover measures set up in December 1986... expired on March 24 and were not renewed," Franck Riboud told French weekly Le Journal des Finances in an interview due to released on Saturday.

But today Danone believes that it has reached a size that makes anti-takeover measures obsolete, he said.

" At the time we thought we had to protect the company because it was in full growth and did not have the size it has now. Today this is a big company that does not need the protection of these measures..," he said.
"We thought it would not be reasonable to ask shareholders to renew these measures," he added.
